text:
Maya: Quick sync — final call for SDK v1.3 release. Changelog cutoff in ~4h (22:00 PT). Anyone blocking sample app builds or docs? @Ryan @Ana
Ryan: Docs PR #442 is waiting on a couple screenshot updates and one small layout fix. I can do screenshots if someone confirms latest widget styles. ETA EOD.
Ana: Sample app CI is flaky on macOS runner — failing during native deps install (node-gyp). I opened a PR: devex/sampleapp#689 to pin node 18 and cache devtools. Failing log:
```
error: node-gyp rebuild failed
npm ERR! errno 1
```
Jordan: I'll take the sampleapp PR review in 30m. Do we need any secrets?
Ana: only REDWOOD_API_KEY in repo secrets — infra confirms staging has it.
Sam: Packaging pipeline blocked by test 'integration:version-check' that expects buildkite tag. For release we can skip it with env SKIP_VERSION_CHECK=true — can we do that for the CI run? Opening hotfix PR now.
Maya: Order of operations — 1) screenshots for docs, 2) sampleapp CI fix + review, 3) SDK packaging hotfix. Sam, please link PR and short changelog note. Ryan, if you can drop screenshots into docs PR I'll merge docs.
devex-bot: changelog-generator scheduled reminder — cutoff at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z (automated). Run command to snapshot PRs:
```
npm run changelog:generate --from=main --to=release/v1.3
```
Jordan: Reviewed #689, left one inline about cache key; good otherwise. Sam: lgtm to skip test for this run — please add follow-up task to reinstate.
Sam: PR 712 created: devex/sdk#712 — SKIP_VERSION_CHECK=true for release pipeline. Added TODO in source.
Maya: Thanks — if no other blockers we'll cut the release at cutoff. Please react :thumbsup: here when you've addressed your item.
